test_data.name: admin_username
test_data.strategy: Resolve an approved administrator account from environment configuration; do not invent credentials.
constraints: Must belong to a user with Admin role in OrangeHRM
Must not be a production account

test_data.name: admin_password
test_data.strategy: Resolve from an approved secret store or .env variable once confirmed; never hardcode.
constraints: Must never appear in logs, reports, or example values

test_data.name: role_option
test_data.strategy: Use an approved Role dropdown value confirmed from application UI or documentation (e.g. Admin, ESS); not yet confirmed.
constraints: Must be one of the values populated in the Add User 'User Role' dropdown

test_data.name: status_option
test_data.strategy: Use an approved Status dropdown value (e.g. Enabled/Disabled) confirmed from application UI; not yet confirmed.
constraints: Must be one of the values populated in the Add User 'Status' dropdown

test_data.name: employee_to_link
test_data.strategy: Look up an existing, non-terminated employee record via an approved API or database source; must not assume a specific employee exists.
constraints: Employee record must already exist in the system
Employee must not already have a linked system user (if that is an application constraint) - unconfirmed

test_data.name: new_username
test_data.strategy: Generate a unique username at run time (e.g. prefix + timestamp/uuid) to avoid collisions across parallel runs.
constraints: Must not already exist as a system user
Must satisfy OrangeHRM username format constraints (unconfirmed max length/character set)
test_data.cleanup_strategy: Delete the created system user via Admin > User Management > Users after the test (see cleanup test_step_data step).

test_data.name: new_user_password
test_data.strategy: Generate a synthetic password at run time satisfying OrangeHRM password policy; never hardcode or log it.
constraints: Must satisfy OrangeHRM password complexity policy (exact rules unconfirmed)

test_data.name: confirm_password
test_data.location: automation runtime generator: same value as new_user_password
test_data.strategy: Reuse the exact value generated for new_user_password to satisfy the confirmation field.

test_data.name: success_notification_message
test_data.strategy: Confirm the exact success toast/notification text from the application UI or documented specification; not yet confirmed.
constraints: Exact wording not confirmed by requirement or application context

test_data.name: base_url
test_data.strategy: Use the configured application base URL for navigation.
constraints: Must point to a non-production OrangeHRM environment

test_step_data.action: Log in to OrangeHRM as an Administrator.
Navigate to Admin > User Management > Users and click Add.
Search and select an existing Employee Name to link.
Verify the success notification is displayed.
Verify the new user appears in the Admin user list.
Cleanup: delete the created system user from Admin > User Management > Users.
